natural forests should be protected from the edge effects of exotic plantations and clear-felled areas.
the effects of land-use change are not restricted to edge areas but can extend deep into natural forests, and therefore, should be considered in regional planning.

the impact of exotic plantation forests extends well beyond their borders into adjacent natural forest.
